definitions.gloss: film studio; soundstage; movie studio lot
definitions.explanation: A facility where films, television shows, or other video productions are shot, including indoor stages and outdoor lots.

examples.japanese: {撮影所|さつえいじょ}を{見学|けんがく}する。
{映画|えいが}の{撮影所|さつえいじょ}は{京都|きょうと}にもいくつかある。
examples.english: There are several film studios in Kyoto as well.

examples.japanese: {俳優|はいゆう}たちは{毎朝|まいあさ}{早|はや}く{撮影所|さつえいじょ}に{入|はい}って{準備|じゅんび}をする。
examples.english: The actors arrive at the studio early every morning to prepare.

notes:
A compound of {撮影|さつえい} (filming/photography) and {所|じょ} (place). Refers to the physical facility where productions are filmed, including sound stages, back lots, and support buildings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {撮影所|さつえいじょ}を{見学|けんがく}する: to tour a film studio
- {撮影所|さつえいじょ}で{撮影|さつえい}する: to film at a studio
- {映画|えいが}{撮影所|さつえいじょ}: movie studio

CULTURAL NOTE:
Famous Japanese film studios include {東映|とうえい}{太秦|うずまさ}{撮影所|さつえいじょ} (Toei Uzumasa Studio) in Kyoto and {東宝|とうほう}スタジオ in Tokyo. The Kyoto studios are known for period dramas ({時代劇|じだいげき}) and some are open to tourists.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- スタジオ: studio (loanword) — used for both film/TV studios and recording studios; more casual
- {映画|えいが}{会社|がいしゃ}: film company — the business entity rather than the physical facility
- セット: set — the specific constructed environment within a studio
